extDescription.message: Read bilingual web pages, captions, PDFs and images. Translate on your device with Chrome or connect your own AI model.

unsupportedPage.message: This page does not allow content scripts.

optionsSubtitle.message: Configure your translation provider, target language and reading preferences.

hintEndpoint.message: Anthropic: use the base URL (https://api.anthropic.com) and pick the Anthropic protocol. For Kimi/Moonshot use the Open Platform base URL, not Kimi Code /coding/v1.

hintApiKey.message: Stored locally in this browser only and sent solely to your endpoint.

labelSourceSkip.message: Skip text already in the target language

labelTranslateUiText.message: Translate UI text too — nav, sidebar, buttons (replaced in place, not bilingual)

hintGlossary.message: Optional. The model is asked to honor these term translations.

labelAutoTranslate.message: Auto-translate every site by default (override per site in the popup)

labelFloatingBubble.message: Show the floating button on pages

sitesEmpty.message: No per-site rules yet. Add a hostname rule below.

labelExportKey.message: Include API key in the export (plain text)

toastInputChanged.message: The field changed during translation. Your edits have been kept.

importFail.message: Could not read that settings file.

toastNoText.message: No translatable text found on this page.

toastCopyFailed.message: Copy failed — select the text manually.

toastContextInvalid.message: Extension was reloaded. Reload this page, then translate again.

toastNeedConfig.message: Set an API endpoint and model in Settings first.

errKimiCoding.message: This endpoint/model is Kimi Code (for coding agents only). Use the Moonshot Open Platform base URL (e.g. https://api.moonshot.cn/v1) and a matching API key.

helpStep1.message: On desktop Chrome 138 or later, open an HTTPS page, click Translate this page and approve a language pack if prompted.

helpStep2.message: For a cloud or local model, choose a provider under Connection, enter its details, test the connection and save.

helpStep3.message: Select a word to see its meaning in the surrounding sentence. The browser engine translates the word and sentence separately.

helpStep4.message: Point at a paragraph and tap Alt or Option to translate just that paragraph. Tap again to remove the translation.

helpStep5.message: Set separate reading and writing languages under Translate. Turn on auto-translation from the popup for sites you visit often.

helpTipSites.message: To translate new paragraphs as you scroll on a site, open the extension popup and turn on Auto-translate for the displayed domain.

helpTipGlossary.message: Under Translate, add one glossary entry per line, for example cache=缓存.

helpTipCache.message: Open the Cache section under Translate to check usage or clear saved translations.

helpShortcuts.message: Shortcuts: Alt+T translate/restore page · Alt+S translate selection. Assign the rest at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

setupHint.message: Chrome translation is selected. Try it on a secure webpage or use Test connection to check this device.

popupNeedSetup.message: Using Chrome on-device translation. Choose a model in Settings for more languages.

selectionToolbarAutoHint.message: Show when text is selected; stay out of editable areas.

selectionToolbarManualHint.message: Select text, then use the button below or the context menu. A shortcut can be assigned in Chrome.

selectionToolbarOffHint.message: Hide the selection toolbar on this site. You can still translate a selection with the keyboard shortcut.

selectionToolbarDisabled.message: The selection toolbar is off on this site. Choose Manual or Auto in the extension popup first.

nativePack.message: Download the Chrome language pack for $FROM$ → $TO$?

nativeUnavailable.message: Chrome translation is unavailable here. Try a secure page in desktop Chrome 138+ or configure a model in Settings.

nativePairUnavailable.message: Chrome cannot translate this language pair on this device. Choose another target or configure a model in Settings.

inputUndoHint.message: Draft translated. Press Esc to restore the original.

captionsVideoOnly.message: Open a YouTube video to use bilingual captions.

captionsOn.message: Bilingual captions on. Turn on CC in the player if needed.

readerStart.message: Open a PDF to translate a paragraph, or an image to recognize its text.

ocrLoading.message: Reading the image on this device…

ocrEmpty.message: No text recognized. Try another image or recognition language.

readerPick.message: Click a paragraph on the page to translate it.

readerNoText.message: This page has no selectable text. For a scanned page, open a screenshot as an image.

readerTooLarge.message: Choose a PDF under 100 MB or an image under 24 MB.

readerUseFile.message: This resource could not be opened. Save it locally and choose Open file.

imageStart.message: Right-click a webpage image and choose Read and translate image, or open an image file here.

nativeHint.message: Chrome can translate supported languages on this device. To use an AI model instead, fill in the connection below and save.

maskSensitive.message: Mask email addresses and phone numbers before sending to a provider

consistentTerms.message: Generate a shared glossary for long pages (one extra model request)

helpMedia.message: On YouTube, enable CC and choose Bilingual captions in the popup. Find PDFs in PDF & image reader and use the context menu on images.

helpWriting.message: Right-click an editable field to translate a draft. Start it with /ja and a space for Japanese. Esc restores the last replacement in that field.

nativePackFailed.message: Chrome could not load this language pack. Check your connection and try again, or select a configured model in Settings.
